newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 slips led by most major issues.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 slips led by most major issues.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index declined slightly at Monday's fixing led by major issues, most of whom announced sharply lower first half 1997 results last week.

SPT Telecom, which was the one high cap whose results were generally hailed as positive, fell back 10 crowns to 3,800. SPT had posted solid gains in anticipation of and just after the publication of its results.
Power utility CEZ fell back eight crowns to 910. On Friday, CEZ saw its second quarter net profits fall by around 70 percent compared with the same period in 1996.
The banking sector, whose results were almost uniformly recieved negatively, had a mixed morning. The most heavily capitalised banking issue, Komercni Banka rose five crowns to 1,640.
However, Ceska Sporitelna fell three crowns to 261 and IPB was down six crowns to 215.
